g.text: Filtered 1.0 V / 1.2 V rails supply the GTP block.

g.desc: Filtered 1.0 V / 1.2 V rails supply the GTP block.

g.text: ASIC capture uses each chip's returned clock.

g.desc: ASIC capture uses each chip's returned clock.

g.text: Kelvin sense at FPGA; brownout response needs validation.

g.desc: Kelvin sense at FPGA; brownout response needs validation.

g.text: EFUSE_RTN (pad 17) must stay separate from GND.

g.desc: EFUSE_RTN (pad 17) must stay separate from GND.

g.text: Custom cable: power, JTAG and serial data.

g.desc: Custom cable: power, JTAG and serial data.

g.text: 125 MHz reference for the serial link.

g.desc: 125 MHz reference for the serial link.

g.text: Local bypass for FPGA power pins and I/O banks.

g.desc: Local bypass for FPGA power pins and I/O banks.

g.text: Invalid FPGA rails hold INIT_B / PROGRAM_B low.

g.desc: Invalid FPGA rails hold INIT_B / PROGRAM_B low.

g.text: Cable data: 1.2 V. FPGA JTAG: 1.5 V.

g.desc: Cable data: 1.2 V. FPGA JTAG: 1.5 V.

g.text: JP30-JP33 select cable (1-2) or local (2-3) JTAG.

g.desc: JP30-JP33 select cable (1-2) or local (2-3) JTAG.

g.text: 3.0 V feeds the ASIC branch. Boot flash uses 1.8 V.

g.desc: 3.0 V feeds the ASIC branch. Boot flash uses 1.8 V.

g.text: 1.0 V core, 1.8 V auxiliary and 1.5 V I/O.

g.desc: 1.0 V core, 1.8 V auxiliary and 1.5 V I/O.

g.text: J6 holds INIT_B low for manual recovery.

g.desc: J6 holds INIT_B low for manual recovery.

g.text: NVT4858 links 1.5 V FPGA to 1.8 V SPI x1 flash.

g.desc: NVT4858 links 1.5 V FPGA to 1.8 V SPI x1 flash.

g.text: 35T FPGA PCB | Power, startup and serial link

g.desc: 35T FPGA PCB | Power, startup and serial link

g.text: U81 limits the ASIC feed; enable follows I/O power-good.

g.desc: U81 limits the ASIC feed; enable follows I/O power-good.

g.text: Full part specifications are in symbol properties. Matching net labels connect across both sheets.

g.desc: Full part specifications are in symbol properties. Matching net labels connect across both sheets.
